title: [finding] The mandated `Served-tier:` top line puts a model identifier in a GitHub comment, which AGENTS.md:442 forbids in terms — and a p1 guard change would cement it into a gate
body:
⚠️ **Re-filed** — original destroyed with the `os-musk` suspension. Re-verified today. Bare and **ungraded**.

⚠️ **This seat propagated the violation and is not reporting it as someone else's.** Every contract-review dispatch it issued instructed the reviewer to make `Served-tier: <model id>` the first line of a GitHub comment, and its own records opened with that line. It has stopped.

## The conflict, both sides quoted

**`AGENTS.md:442`**, verbatim on `origin/main`:

> …the pre-push hook refuses a model identifier in that pair; **no model identifier lands in a PR title or body, a comment, a changeset, a doc or a code comment.**

⇒ **"a comment" is named explicitly.** The rule is not scoped to commits and PR bodies.

**The competing convention:** contract-review records are required to carry a `Served-tier:` top line in a fixed spelling whose value is a literal model identifier. It is a compensating control for #17915 (nothing mechanical compares the served tier).

**Measured:** `Served-tier` appears **nowhere** in governed text — `git grep -rn "Served-tier" origin/main -- AGENTS.md .claude/ scripts/ skills/` returns **0**, with `AGENTS.md` demonstrably readable by the same instrument. ⇒ the prohibition lives in `AGENTS.md`; the convention lives only in ruling comments and seat practice.

**Priority order** (pm-dispatch SKILL.md): 维护者裁决 > **`AGENTS.md`** > 红线 > 核心条款 > 细则 > 座位判断.

## ⭐ Why this is cheap rather than a real trade-off

The protocol **already states that a self-reported tier is not evidence** — `references/contract-review.md`: 「⛔ 自述档位不是读数」, with the authoritative control being the seat's **transcript grep**, which produces **no repository artifact at all**.

⇒ the artifact that violates AGENTS.md is the one the protocol already declares non-evidential.

A shape that appears to satisfy both, ⛔ not decided here: *"served at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; verified by the seat from the round's transcript, N/N records, against a control transcript at the default tier."* Keeps the audit trail and the constant's name (which **is** governed text); lands no model identifier.

## ⚠️ The urgency is in the tense

Measured on `origin/main` **today**: `Served-tier` appears **0** times in `scripts/pm/`, while lit control `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` reads **3** in `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` itself. ⇒ no gate reads it *yet*.

But **#18020** (`domain:skills`, `priority:p1`) describes a merge-queue guard shape in which `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` C6/C7 recognise a review comment by *"…`Served-tier:` equal to `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`"*. ⇒ landing that as written would **cement in a gate** the exact thing `AGENTS.md:442` forbids, and a gate is much harder to walk back than a habit.

**The cheap moment to reconcile is before #18020 lands.** ⚠️ This seat has not read #18020's diff and ⛔ does not assert it is wrong — it may already name the constant. The point is the two must be read together.

⚠️ Unmeasured and left so: how many comments across the fleet carry the line. Bears on whether a fix needs a migration.

**Cross-links:** #18020 · #17991 · #17915
